Constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, contract and dead address.
Constructor calls _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair for the new pair.
Constructor mints the full supply to msg.sender.
_transfer calls swapBack when canSwap conditions are satisfied.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens to ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH remain.

swapBack executes the ETH transfer to devWallet.
swapBack executes the ETH transfer to marketingWallet.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap with block.timestamp deadline.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH with block.timestamp deadline.
_transfer computes fees and mutates sellTotalFees/buyTotalFees with unchecked (Solidity 0.8 checked) arithmetic.
_transfer auto-blacklists recipients within three blocks of launchedAt.
msg.sender is the caller used as the transferFrom spender inside Chire.
msg.sender receives the entire minted supply in the constructor.
tx.origin keys the per-block transfer delay mapping, allowing indirect origin-based restrictions.
block.timestamp records _holderFirstBuyTimestamp and decides early-sell tax applicability.
block.timestamp comparison selects the early sell fee values written into sellTotalFees.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
Owner address initializes marketingWallet.
Owner address initializes devWallet.
launchedAt block number defines the auto-blacklist window applied to buyers.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the token-for-ETH swap.
tokensForLiquidity determines the liquidity share in swapBack and is reset to zero.
tokensForMarketing determines the marketing share in swapBack and is reset to zero.
tokensForDev determines the dev share in swapBack and is reset to zero.
marketingWallet is the destination of the final full-balance ETH call.
devWallet is the destination of the dev ETH call.
Transfer amount feeds the fee multiplication/division arithmetic.
from participates in exemption, AMM pair and limit checks inside _transfer.
to is the address written into _blacklist during the launch window.
Chire recipients array drives each transferFrom destination.
Chire values array drives each transferFrom amount.
Loop index bounds the owner-funded transferFrom loop.
newAmount replaces swapTokensAtAmount after bound checks.
newNum replaces maxTransactionAmount after scaling.
fees value is derived from and used in the fee arithmetic.
contractTokenBalance gates whether swapBack runs.
canSwap triggers the swapBack call path.
takeFee decides whether the fee arithmetic executes.
isBuy selects the buy vs sell fee branch that mutates sellTotalFees.
contractBalance is the base amount distributed in swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap is the denominator for ETH distribution in swapBack.
liquidityTokens is passed to addLiquidity.
amountToSwapForETH is passed to swapTokensForEth.
ethBalance determines the amounts sent to the external wallets.
ethForMarketing is the share sent to the marketing wallet.
ethForDev is the share sent to the dev wallet.
ethForLiquidity is paired with liquidityTokens in addLiquidity.
path array is supplied to the router swap call.
tokenAmount is approved and swapped by the router call.
totalSupply constant is the minted amount.
account key is written into the fee-exclusion mapping, changing fee/limit behavior.
pair address is written into the AMM pair mapping, changing buy/sell classification.
External ETH send to devWallet returns control while swapBack continues to send more ETH.
External ETH send to marketingWallet can reenter token entry points before returning.
Router swap callback can reenter _transfer flow, which is only partly guarded by the swapping flag.
addLiquidityETH external call can reenter the transfer path while token state is mid-update.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter of _transfer used only for its checks and super._transfer call.
to is a parameter of _transfer used for blacklist, limit and fee logic.
amount is the operand of the fee multiplication/division arithmetic.
fees is the result of the fee arithmetic and is transferred to the contract.
contractTokenBalance is a scratch local used only inside _transfer.
canSwap is the condition that invokes swapBack.
takeFee gates execution of the fee arithmetic block.
isBuy is a branch selector local inside _transfer.
contractBalance is the cached balance local of swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap is the distribution denominator local of swapBack.
liquidityTokens is the token argument supplied to addLiquidity.
amountToSwapForETH is the token amount supplied to swapTokensForEth.
ethBalance drives the ETH amount sent to the external wallets.
ethForMarketing is the value forwarded to the marketing wallet call.
ethForDev is the value forwarded to the dev wallet call.
ethForLiquidity is the ETH value supplied to addLiquidity.
recipients provides the destinations of the Chire transferFrom loop.
values provides the amounts of the Chire transferFrom loop.
i is the loop counter of the Chire transferFrom loop.
newAmount is the parameter written to swapTokensAtAmount.
newNum is the parameter written to maxTransactionAmount.
account is the parameter keyed into the fee-exclusion mapping.
pair is the parameter written into the AMM pair mapping.
path is a temporary array passed to the router swap.
tokenAmount is the approved/swapped amount passed to the router.
totalSupply local is the fixed amount passed to _mint.
